description: The line plot illustrates the Loss Ratio (%) compared across different TFLOPs for five model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and features a mixed scale, starting with non-linear intervals at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, and 1e8, followed by linear intervals of 1e8 up to a maximum value of 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, marked at regular intervals of 1. The "Vanilla" configuration is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers, which remains perfectly steady at a value of 100 across the entire x-axis from 1e7 to 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=64)" configuration is shown as a solid orange line with vertical tick markers; it begins at approximately 98.3 at 1e7, rises to about 100.1 at 2e8, reaches a peak of roughly 100.4 at 4e8, and then stabilizes near 100, ending at exactly 100 at 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=128)" configuration, depicted by a solid dark blue line with 'x' markers, starts at approximately 97.0 at 1e7, increases steadily to about 99.9 at 2e8, and maintains a steady trend just below 100, concluding at roughly 99.8 at 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" configuration is indicated by a solid green line with diamond markers, starting at approximately 97.5 at 1e7, climbing to near 100 at 2e8, experiencing a slight dip to 99.8 at 3e8, peaking at roughly 100.2 at 6e8, and finishing at approximately 99.9 at 9e8. Finally, the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" configuration is represented by a solid red line with circle markers. It begins at the lowest point of exactly 94.0 at 1e7, exhibits a sharp increase to 98.0 at 1e8, peaks at approximately 99.1 at 4e8, drops to 98.4 at 5e8, and ends with a slight decline to roughly 98.7 at 9e8.
